title: 第15章 算什么男人第16章 太监自卫术
lines: 面对突如其来的热情，吴谦可不会矜持。
他才懒得故作矜持，以博取长辈的欢心。
吴谦是生怕要的少了，过去这高兴劲，老太监再不认账。
于是立即狮子大开口，直接表明想要隐藏境界的方法。
吴谦表现越直接，吴厚反而越兴奋，心里不断念叨，
“老实人啊，老实人！”
大手一挥，便从屁股底下掏出一枚玉简，递到吴谦面前，
“拿去吧！”
吴谦一个战术后仰，双手隔着袖子接过玉简，看起来格外恭敬。
吴厚更开心了，再次大手一挥，从屁股下边拿出一个瓷瓶，「啪」的一声拍在案上。
“把这个也拿去！”
正气丹一枚，用来提升突破炼气成功率。
对这枚丹药，吴谦倒不是很大兴趣，自己有系统加持，突破瓶颈应该不成问题
大不了拿道德值砸过去，反正手里有大把道德值。
还有就是……啥东西都往屁股底下放，这玩意还能吃么……
吴谦纠结不已……
见吴谦犹豫，吴厚还以为他不好意思，直接把瓶子塞他手里，大方说道，
“给你就拿着！”
“等你到了炼气境，就能和其他人平起平坐，以后在药膳房用不着拘束，想干嘛就干嘛。”
吴谦拿在手里，试着提议道，
“我现在才八阶，还用不上这么好的东西，要不您看看有谁急用，先让给他们，我到时候再想办法。”
“你呀，就是心忒善！”
“明明已性命攸关，却还惦记着别人。”
吴厚摇头苦笑，语重心长的说道，
“但你要记住，身在药膳房，丹药乃是大忌，我又怎能让别人知晓，更毋谈赠予他人了。”
“明白了！”
吴谦郑重点头，第一次由衷感激老太监。
正如吴厚所说，身为药膳房总管，拥有任何丹药，都逃脱不了监守自盗的嫌疑。
不敢让别人知道的事情，如今却直接赠予吴谦，何尝不是将把柄交于吴谦，摆明已将其视为自己人。
吴谦将正气丹小心收好，为不辜负吴厚善意，下定决心就算捏着鼻子，也要吃下去。
吴厚这才满意，笑问吴谦还有没有其他事情。
吴谦知道该走了，连忙施礼告退。
临走时，吴厚淡淡提醒道，
content_en:
Wu Qian would not be reserved in the face of sudden enthusiasm.
He didn't bother to pretend to be reserved in order to win the favor of his elders.
Wu Qian was afraid that he would want less. The old eunuch would not admit his happiness in the past.
So the lion immediately opened his mouth and directly stated that he wanted to hide his realm.
The more direct Wu Qian acted, the more excited Wu Hou became, and he kept thinking in his heart,
"Honest man, honest man!"
With a wave of his hand, he took out a jade slip from under his buttocks and handed it to Wu Qian.
"Take it!"
Wu Qian leaned back and took the jade slip through his sleeves with both hands, looking particularly respectful.
Wu Hou became even happier. He waved his hand again, took out a porcelain bottle from under his butt, and slapped it on the table with a "pop".
"Take this too!"
A righteousness pill, used to increase the success rate of breakthrough in refining qi.
Wu Qian is not very interested in this elixir. He has the support of the system, so it should not be a problem to break through the bottleneck.
The worst case scenario is to throw moral points at him, since he has a lot of moral points in his hand anyway.
And...if you put everything under your butt, can you still eat it...
Wu Qian was confused...
Seeing Wu Qian's hesitation, Wu Hou thought he was embarrassed and directly put the bottle into his hand and said generously,
"Take it if you give it to me!"
"When you reach the Qi Refining Realm, you will be on an equal footing with others. From now on, you don't need to be restrained in the medicinal kitchen. You can do whatever you want."
Wu Qian held it in his hand and tried to suggest,
"I'm only at the eighth level now, so I don't need such a good thing yet. Why don't you see who needs it urgently and give it to them first, and I'll think of a solution then."
"You have such a kind heart!"
"Even though your life is at stake, you still think about others."
Wu Hou shook his head and smiled bitterly, and said seriously,
"But you have to remember that in the medicine room, elixirs are taboo. How can I let others know about it, let alone give it to others."
"Got it!"
Wu Qian nodded solemnly, feeling sincerely grateful to the old eunuch for the first time.
As Wu Hou said, as the manager of the medicinal kitchen, any elixir he possesses will not escape the suspicion of being guarded and stolen.
Things that he did not dare to let others know were now directly given to Wu Qian. Why not hand over the handle to Wu Qian and make it clear that he is one of his own.
Wu Qian carefully put away the righteousness pill, and in order to live up to Wu Hou's good intentions, he made up his mind to eat it even if he pinched his nose.
Wu Hou was satisfied and asked Wu Qian with a smile if there was anything else.
Wu Qian knew it was time to leave and quickly bowed and left.
Before leaving, Wu Hou reminded lightly,
title_en: Chapter 15 What kind of man is this? Chapter 16 Eunuch’s self-defense skills
